shared.title: The First Pages
shared.description: Every oath begins with a journey. Explore Upper Guk, Unrest and Runnyeye. Find their entrances, learn the way home, and prepare escape and recovery tools before going deeper. Your Tasks window records each visit. Return to the Ancient Chronicler in the East Commonlands tunnel for the next chapter.

shared.title: Beneath the Surface
shared.description: Earn your first dungeon victories. Defeat the froglok warden in Upper Guk and the reclusive ghoul magus in Unrest. Plan around linked pulls, runners and spell interruption. Victory itself is the proof; you do not need a rare quest drop. Ordinary group and pet kill credit applies to your individual journal.

shared.title: Steel and Sorcery
shared.description: Face Battlelord Paluk in Runnyeye and the goblin sage in Permafrost. Prepare for physical pressure and hostile magic, manage recovery between pulls, and learn when to retreat. After both victories, return to the Ancient Chronicler. At level 35, five archetype paths become available, regardless of your Primary class.

paths.title: Guardian: The Unbroken Oath
paths.description: Learn to survive pressure without exhausting your recovery. Defeat the froglok shin lord in Upper Guk and Lord Pickclaw in Runnyeye, then face Xicotl in Mistmoore. Prepare a safe fighting position and reserve a defensive answer for the final pull. Completion unlocks the Guardian attunement. Return to the Chronicler to forge or attune your Epic 0.5 charm.
paths.effect_text: Absorb 15% of melee damage, up to 200 damage total, for at most 3 ticks.

paths.title: Striker: A Decisive Hand
paths.description: Master controlled aggression in Mistmoore. Defeat Butler Syncall and Maid Issis before facing Garton Viswin. Choose where you fight, prevent runners from widening a pull, and keep enough endurance for the next engagement. Completion unlocks the Striker attunement; return to the Chronicler to claim it.
paths.effect_text: Gain a 6% melee damage modifier for at most 3 ticks; normal stacking rules apply.

paths.title: Arcanist: The Measured Flame
paths.description: Win with deliberate use of magic and resources. Defeat Battlewizard Unak in Runnyeye and High Priest Zaharn in Permafrost, then face Lasna Cheroon in Mistmoore. Vary your damage types, consider control and interruption, and plan your mana recovery. Completion unlocks the Arcanist attunement; return to the Chronicler to claim it.
paths.effect_text: Gain a 5% spell damage focus for direct damage and DoTs for at most 3 ticks; normal stacking rules apply.

paths.title: Warden: The Last Light
paths.description: Balance recovery against the cost of staying in the fight. Defeat Khrix Fritchoff in Unrest and Maid Issis in Mistmoore, then return to Unrest to face Garanel Rucksif. Keep an emergency resource in reserve and avoid turning each pull into a battle of attrition. Completion unlocks the Warden attunement; return to the Chronicler to claim it.
paths.effect_text: Instantly restore 10% of your maximum HP, capped at 400 base healing before normal healing bonuses.

paths.title: Binder: An Unbroken Bond
paths.description: Practice precise pet control and keep yourself alive alongside your companions. Defeat King Thex'Ka IV in Permafrost and Mynthi Davissi in Mistmoore, then face Xicotl. Plan pet positioning, retreats and recovery; additional pets should never pull more than you can manage. Completion unlocks the Binder attunement; return to the Chronicler to claim it.
paths.effect_text: One targeted owned pet gains an 8% melee damage modifier and 10% melee absorption (150 damage cap), for at most 3 ticks.
